notes:
Controllers no longer go dead after the console has been running for many hours. The right
Joy-Con was usually the first to stop, and any pad that reconnected after that came back
unusable. The cause was ours: a reading the launcher took every few seconds was slowly
starving the part of the system that hands out controllers.

Two new emulator engines, each picked per game in that game's Performance settings. DS
games can now run on DraStic, and PSP games can now run on standalone PPSSPP. The engines
you already use stay the default and are unchanged, and your in-game DS save moves between
melonDS and DraStic automatically so you can switch mid playthrough. Neither new engine has
been played with a controller in hand yet, so reports are welcome.

Gen1Recomp keeps your settings now. The color palette and game speed no longer reset every
time you reopen the game, mods should stay switched on instead of reverting, and the mod
manager actually appears when you pick it from the in-game menu. Ports also have box art,
stay fullscreen after they update themselves, and say what happened when they crash.

New Cover art tab on the console's web page: search SteamGridDB and pick your own box art
for any game. It needs your own free key, pasted once on that tab.

Also: DS games now launch at the Overclock profile and hold a flat 60 fps, PS1 games get a
DualShock with the sticks live, DS and 3DS can drive a touch screen pointer with the right
stick, the Favorites tab can be sorted and can be the tab you land on, and new RAM tuning
runs leave AC mode off for less heat and more battery.

Fixed: PS2 games opening with a Translation Error box every launch, Wii U graphic packs not
working on single file .wua games, and the stats overlay defaulting to a shape that tore.
